hypotheses.justification: The proof uses `hlen` only to turn `hi : i < (C.stepOfL Δ).length` into the bound needed by `IH`. But `hlab i hi` says `labelAt (x ++ [i])` is `some ...`; by `QuasiTab.atOpt_append` and `hx`, this implies that `i` is a valid child index in `next`, hence `i < next.length`. So the proof can obtain `hi'` from `hlab i hi` and `hx` instead. The statement remains true without `hlen`; the degenerate case of an out-of-range child cannot satisfy `hlab`.
